blurb: Desert Mountain Club is a private club set within 8,300 acres of Sonoran Desert in North Scottsdale. It features six Jack Nicklaus Signature Championship golf courses plus a seventh short course, seven clubhouses, 10 restaurants, a large fitness and wellness center, tennis and pickleball courts, and private hiking trails. The club offers a vibrant lifestyle with social clubs and events for members of all ages.
